jobs.description:
Treasury Analyst

Job Locations

US-IN-Fort Wayne

ID

2026-7834

Pos. Category

Professional

Subsidiary

Steel Dynamics

Overview

Reports directly to Treasury Director focusing on 1) analysis, reporting, and reconciliation of hedging activity between external and internal information; 2) daily cash monitoring and payment processes; and 3) analysis of other treasury topics as needed.

Responsibilities

Treasury Finance
- Coordinate information from accounting, operations, trading, and risk management to reconcile exchange-traded derivative positions between broker statements and our internal system of record.
- Perform monthly closing and reporting processes related to realized and unrealized exchange-traded derivative positions
- Supporting daily cash functions including payment processes and intercompany activities
- Works to drive improved control and efficiencies across treasury banking process. Eliminate redundancies and inconsistencies
- Supports the treasury director as needed, coordinates the accumulation of various financial analyses, and assists in the preparation of the summary materials for executive leadership and Board of Directors.

Overall Responsibilities
- Support other various treasury fun ctions
- Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting and/or finance; pursing CPA or MBA or other financial certification
- Entry level to 3 years of relevant accounting and financial analysis experience
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Effective written and verbal communication skills

Overview

The Marketing Specialist will be developing, implementing and tracking marketing programs such as promotional strategies, digital campaigns, and social media across all divisions.

Responsibilities

- Develop, implement and maintain a corporate social media strategy. - Analyze trends with social media.
- Creation of content calendar and guidelines.

- Collaborate with other internal teams to develop and monitor strategic marketing initiatives.
- Develop, create and maintain marketing and recruiting materials and ensure brand guidelines are met
- Conduct market research and develop strategies based on industry trends and demographics.
- Write, proofread, and edit creative materials
- Maintain marketing budget.
- Photography as requested within the divisions.
- Video / filming and editing of video within the divisions as requested.
- Assist in marketing recruiting efforts and events.
- Maintain Omni website and update as needed.
- Develop company podcasts.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or related field
- 2-5 years’ experience in marketing
- Proficient in creating and editing video and photography content utilizing appropriate software
- Working knowledge of social media platforms
- Proficiency in creation of social media posts
- Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and SharePoint
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to use sound judgment
- Self-starter with a willingness to take initiative and the ability to work with minimal supervision to bring projects to completion
